g.text: Direct wires, NOT through the breadboard (female-to-male jumpers, module end female):

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: TM1637 CLK → Uno D2 (yellow) TM1637 DIO → Uno D4 (white)

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: DS3231 SDA → Uno A4 (purple) DS3231 SCL → Uno A5 (cyan)

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: Bottom wires (labelled with Uno pin) go to the Uno header sockets.

g.text: KY-006 module instead of PS1240: S → D8, − → GND rail, via jumpers (see WIRING.md).

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: Rails: check yours are continuous end to end (some boards split them in the middle).

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: Red/black wires from the rails to the modules hop over the other rail; they do not touch it.
